adds.rationale: Oklo just completed its SPAC listing and immediately produced the exact buildup-phase tell the profile names for nuclear -- a hyperscaler data-center power deal -- making it the cleanest quiet-buildup entry into the fission/SMR wave available this quarter.

news_evidence.summary: Oklo Inc. began trading on the NYSE under ticker OKLO after AltC Acquisition Corp shareholders approved the SPAC merger, with $306M gross proceeds and Sam Altman as board chairman.
Oklo signed a non-binding letter of intent with Wyoming Hyperscale to deliver 100 megawatts via a planned 20-year power purchase agreement to power an AI-driven data center campus.

removes.rationale: Defense has been rallying for two-plus years and is now priced for perfection: Lockheed beat Q1 top- and bottom-line estimates yet the stock sold off on weak cash flow, signaling the wave's easy re-rating is behind it relative to nuclear's fresher entry point.

news_evidence.summary: Lockheed Martin reported Q1 2024 net sales of $17.2B beating estimates, but shares fell on the week as cash flow disappointed and guidance underwhelmed.

rationale_overall: Net effect: swap a mature, richly-priced defense holding (LMT) for a genuinely early-innings nuclear name (OKLO) whose first commercial deal directly matches the profile's own stated tell for the nuclear wave -- SMR power sold to AI data centers -- while AI (MSFT, NVDA), rockets (RKLB, still showing 69% YoY revenue growth and Neutron progress), and quantum (IONQ) hold unchanged since none showed a thesis breach or peak-enthusiasm signal this quarter. Robotics and eldercare/demographics turned up only generic, undated commentary in this window, not a citable buildup catalyst, so no add was proposed there this cycle.
